verdict.rationale: Bento is an agent observability platform with an SDK and CLI, so opting out of the product's own telemetry is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents a telemetry opt-out, a do-not-track setting, or any usage-tracking control for the SDK, CLI, or dashboard. The OTel-transport note about skipping 'the analytics layer' describes how customer traces are routed, which is an adjacent feature and not a way to opt out of Bento's own usage tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
